title: RoboCup Singapore
text: I volunteered at RoboCup 2025 at the Singapore Science Centre. On Day 1, I manned the shirt distribution booth for all the attendees, and I even got to watch a game of soccer played by robots, quite an interesting sight! On Day 3, I sorted the trophies by category and age group, and kept the slides updated with the latest results for the awards ceremony.
